name: Payoff's Edge
flavor: Sharpens the moment a mark is cashed in.

name: Guard's Bulwark
flavor: Roots the wearer to the spot, and the spot to the ground.

name: Setter's Wit
flavor: Always one step ahead of the mark.

name: Support's Grace
flavor: Keeps the wearer on their feet so the team stays on theirs.

name: Spark Luck
flavor: Lightning likes to strike twice for its own.

name: Ember Fury
flavor: Burns brightest on the hardest hit.

name: Tide Flow
flavor: Moves like water finding its way downhill.

name: Grove Hide
flavor: Bark grows thick where it is needed most.

name: Steady Hand
flavor: Nothing flashy, just a little more behind every hit.
